lines.text: If this is your kid's Saturday…
But watch this before you hand over the iPad again.
It's 9 AM. They're already on a screen.
lines.say: It's nine A.M. They're already on a screen.

lines.text: "Mom, I'm bored" — for the hundredth time.
lines.say: Mom, I'm bored. For the hundredth time.

lines.text: And you're googling how to get them off it… again.
Kids eight to twelve now average five and a half hours of screens. Every single day.
What they actually need? A ball. A team. A coach who believes in them.
That's Euro Soccer USA's Fall Academy.
Weekend soccer classes in LA for ages four to twelve,
with European-trained coaches, grouped by age and ability.
Voted #1 in LA, with 10,000+ kids coached.
lines.say: Voted number one in LA, with over ten thousand kids coached.

lines.text: 8 weeks from now, you'll notice it.
lines.say: Eight weeks from now, you'll notice it.

lines.text: More confidence. Real friends. Real skills.
And a kid who asks, "Is it Saturday yet?"
lines.say: And a kid who asks: is it Saturday yet?
